correctness.rationale: The stated all-p positive-input no-absorption envelope follows from nearest-even predecessor/successor midpoint enclosures: for each strictly advancing rounded addition the positive exact addend is at least half the observed increment and at most 3/2 of it except at powers of two. The exceptional extra gap sums geometrically to at most 2^{-p}F, proving (F+x1)/2 <= S <= (3/2+2^{-p})F-x1/2 even across exponent boundaries. The constructed addends (1/2+2^{-p})Delta and (3/2-2^{1-p})Delta are normalized representable floats and lie in the immediate-successor rounding cell, giving asymptotic F/S=2 and 2/3 only after J→∞ then p→∞. Independent rational nearest-even implementation checked 1,488 constructed advancing steps at p=3..7 and J=1..3, including both exact sum identities; bounded corroboration only. The upper coefficient is NOT claimed sharp at each fixed p. No exponent limits/subnormal IEEE claim is inferred.
